title: Shein’s Slow India Start Lays Bare Limits of Billionaire Ambani’s Retail Might
teaser: Shein Global Holdings Ltd.’s return to India through a local partner is off to a slow start, due to supply chain snags, leadership uncertainty and a lack of proprietary technology that made the fast-fashion brand a hit.

title: Rupee Has Room to Rally Before RBI Steps In, Strategists Say
teaser: India’s rupee is pulling away from its Asian peers, and strategists say the rally has further to run before the central bank steps in to buy dollars.

title: Oil Rises Amid Ongoing Middle East Tensions
teaser: Oil rose in early Asian trade amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East, countering expectations of a supply surplus.

title: Situational Awareness Lost 65% in Wild Third Quarter, WSJ Says
teaser: Situational Awareness told investors it lost 65% after fees in the third quarter, after highly levered bets on artificial intelligence firms nearly led to the hedge fund’s implosion in July, according to the Wall Street Journal.

title: Lula Sounds Out Bradesco’s Luiz Trabuco to Join His Government
teaser: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has sounded out Bradesco Chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco Cappi about joining his fourth-term government, according to people familiar with the matter, a move that could help ease investor concerns over Brazil’s deteriorating fiscal outlook.

title: Australia Capex Surges by Most Since Mining Boom on Data Centers
teaser: Australian business investment surged by the most since the peak of the mining boom in the three months through September, driven by data center-related spending in a bright spot for an otherwise cooling economy.

title: Modi’s Criticism of India Inc. Puts Weak Investment in Focus
teaser: Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s sharp criticism of Indian businesses last week exposed an underlying weakness in the economy’s booming growth story.

title: ‘Jensanity’ erupts in Taiwan and China on Nvidia founder’s comeback
teaser: Jensen Huang is among the few business leaders to straddle both sides of the Taiwan Strait

title: Gold Edges Lower Amid Rate Hike Bets
teaser: Gold edged lower in early Asian trade as U.S. inflation data reinforces expectations of further rate increases.

title: Nikkei Rises 1.3%, Led by Chip, Metals Stocks
teaser: Japanese stocks were higher, rebounding from Wednesday’s sharp declines, thanks partly to signs of U.S. economic strength.

title: Gold Edges Lower as US Inflation Data Fuels Bets for Rate Hikes
teaser: Gold edged lower, after rising on Wednesday, as inflation data reinforced bets the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates further.
